definitions.explanation: The quality of exercising self-control and behaving within appropriate limits. Implies knowing where to draw the line in behavior, consumption, or expression.

examples.japanese: {節度|せつど}のある{行動|こうどう}を{心|こころ}がける。
examples.english: I try to act with moderation.

examples.japanese: お{酒|さけ}は{節度|せつど}を{守|まも}って{飲|の}みましょう。
{彼|かれ}は{常|つね}に{節度|せつど}を{持|も}って{発言|はつげん}するので、{周囲|しゅうい}から{信頼|しんらい}されている。
examples.english: He always speaks with restraint, so he is trusted by those around him.

notes:
USAGE:
{節度|せつど} conveys a sense of measured, appropriate behavior. It is frequently paired with ある (having moderation) or {守|まも}る (maintaining moderation). The word carries a positive connotation of maturity and self-discipline.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {節度|せつど}のある: moderate, restrained
- {節度|せつど}を{守|まも}る: to maintain moderation
- {節度|せつど}を{持|も}つ: to have restraint
- {節度|せつど}ある{態度|たいど}: a restrained attitude
- {節度|せつど}を{欠|か}く: to lack moderation
